back-to-top.code: (() => { const b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.textContent='Back to top'; b.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:1rem;bottom:1rem;z-index:1000'; b.addEventListener('click',()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth'})); document.body.appendChild(b); })();
back-to-top.description: Accessible back-to-top button. Review the code and any example values before enabling.

scroll-progress.description: Reading scroll progress indicator. Review the code and any example values before enabling.

countdown.description: Editable countdown timer. Review the code and any example values before enabling.

social-share.name: Privacy-friendly share link shortcode
social-share.code: add_shortcode( 'codeslot_share', static function () { return 'Share this post'; } );
social-share.description: A plain outgoing share link. No third-party sharing scripts load.

breadcrumbs.name: Simple hierarchical page breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.code:
add_filter( 'the_content', static function ( $content ) { if ( ! is_page() || ! is_main_query() || ! in_the_loop() ) { return $content; } $links = array( 'Home' ); foreach ( array_reverse( get_post_ancestors( get_queried_object_id() ) ) as $id ) { $links[] = '' . esc_html( get_the_title( $id ) ) . ''; } $links[] = esc_html( get_the_title( get_queried_object_id() ) ); return '
' . implode( ' / ', $links ) . '
' . $content; } );
breadcrumbs.description: Simple hierarchical page breadcrumbs. Review and customize before activation.

toc.name: Content heading table of contents
toc.description: Content heading table of contents. Review and customize before activation.

comment-collapse.name: Collapse long comments accessibly
comment-collapse.description: Collapse long comments accessibly. Review and customize before activation.

comment-counter.name: Comment length counter
comment-counter.description: Comment length counter. Review and customize before activation.

custom-page-logo.name: Page-specific custom logo
custom-page-logo.code: add_filter( 'get_custom_logo', static function ( $html ) { if ( is_page( 123 ) ) { return ''; } return $html; } );
custom-page-logo.description: Replace page ID 123 and example image path. Works with themes that use get_custom_logo().

default-featured-image.name: Fallback featured image
default-featured-image.description: Replace attachment ID 123. Provides fallback thumbnail HTML in themes using WordPress thumbnail functions.

avatar-alt.name: Default accessible avatar alternative text
avatar-alt.code: add_filter( 'get_avatar_data', static function ( $args ) { if ( empty( $args['alt'] ) ) { $args['alt'] = 'User avatar'; } return $args; } );
avatar-alt.description: Default accessible avatar alternative text. Review and customize before activation.

custom-default-avatar.name: Custom default avatar URL
custom-default-avatar.code: add_filter( 'avatar_defaults', static function ( $defaults ) { $defaults[ esc_url_raw( home_url( '/wp-content/uploads/default-avatar.png' ) ) ] = 'Site avatar'; return $defaults; } );
custom-default-avatar.description: Replace the image URL, then select Site avatar in Settings → Discussion.

contributor-uploads.name: Allow contributors to upload media once
contributor-uploads.description: Persistent role change: contributors gain upload permission. Requires explicit Run Once confirmation. To undo, remove upload_files from that role; deleting this snippet does not undo it.

disable-taxonomies.name: Remove default post categories and tags
disable-taxonomies.description: Remove default post categories and tags. Review and customize before activation.

disable-post-formats.name: Remove post format theme support
disable-post-formats.description: Remove post format theme support. Review and customize before activation.

disable-anonymous-rest.name: Require authentication for REST API
disable-anonymous-rest.code: add_filter( 'rest_authentication_errors', static function ( $result ) { if ( $result ) { return $result; } return is_user_logged_in() ? $result : new WP_Error( 'rest_login_required', 'Authentication required.', array( 'status' => 401 ) ); } );
disable-anonymous-rest.description: Blocks anonymous REST requests. Can break headless frontends, checkout blocks and third-party integrations. Review on staging.

fullscreen-editor.name: Disable initial editor fullscreen mode
fullscreen-editor.description: Disable initial editor fullscreen mode. Review and customize before activation.

editor-palette.name: Custom editor color palette
editor-palette.description: Custom editor color palette. Review and customize before activation.

site-health-title.name: Hide update notices from non-administrators
site-health-title.code: add_action( 'admin_head', static function () { if ( ! current_user_can( 'update_core' ) ) { remove_action( 'admin_notices', 'update_nag', 3 ); } } );
site-health-title.description: Hide update notices from non-administrators. Review and customize before activation.

howdy.name: Customize toolbar greeting
howdy.code: add_action( 'admin_bar_menu', static function ( $bar ) { $node = $bar->get_node( 'my-account' ); if ( $node ) { $bar->add_node( array( 'id' => 'my-account', 'title' => str_replace( 'Howdy,', 'Welcome,', $node->title ) ) ); } }, 999 );
howdy.description: Customize toolbar greeting. Review and customize before activation.

offer-popup.name: Dismissible local offer message
offer-popup.code: (() => {const box=document.createElement('aside');box.setAttribute('aria-label','Special offer');box.style.cssText='position:fixed;bottom:1rem;right:1rem;max-width:18rem;padding:1rem;background:white;color:#17243a;border:1px solid;z-index:999';const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent='Replace this example with your offer.';const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent='Dismiss';b.addEventListener('click',()=>box.remove());box.append(p,b);document.body.appendChild(box);})();
offer-popup.description: Dismissible local offer message. Review and customize before activation.

social-links.code: Our social profile
social-links.description: Accessible social profile links. Review and customize before activation.

fade-navigation.name: Reduced-motion-aware content entrance
fade-navigation.code: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .entry-content { animation: codeslot-enter .25s ease; } @keyframes codeslot-enter { from { opacity: .2; } to { opacity: 1; } } }
fade-navigation.description: Reduced-motion-aware content entrance. Review and customize before activation.

disable-trash-emptying.name: Stop automatic trash emptying
disable-trash-emptying.description: Prevents the scheduled WordPress trash purge while active. Existing trashed content remains. Restore this scheduled callback by deactivating the snippet.

duplicate-post.name: Nonce-protected duplicate draft action
duplicate-post.code: add_filter( 'post_row_actions', static function ( $actions, $post ) { if ( current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) { $url = wp_nonce_url( admin_url( 'admin-post.php?action=codeslot_duplicate_content&id=' . $post->ID ), 'codeslot_duplicate_content_' . $post->ID ); $actions['codeslot_duplicate'] = 'Duplicate draft'; } return $actions; }, 10, 2 ); add_action( 'admin_post_codeslot_duplicate_content', static function () { $id = isset( $_GET['id'] ) ? absint( $_GET['id'] ) : 0; check_admin_referer( 'codeslot_duplicate_content_' . $id ); $post = get_post( $id ); if ( ! $post || ! is_post_type_viewable( $post->post_type ) || ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $id ) ) { wp_die( 'Access denied.', '', array( 'response' => 403 ) ); } $type = get_post_type_object( $post->post_type ); if ( ! current_user_can( $type->cap->create_posts ) ) { wp_die( 'Cannot create this content.', '', array( 'response' => 403 ) ); } $new = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => $post->post_type, 'post_status' => 'draft', 'post_title' => $post->post_title . ' (copy)', 'post_content' => $post->post_content, 'post_excerpt' => $post->post_excerpt, 'post_author' => get_current_user_id() ), true ); if ( is_wp_error( $new ) ) { wp_die( esc_html( $new->get_error_message() ) ); } wp_safe_redirect( get_edit_post_link( $new, 'raw' ) ); exit; } );
duplicate-post.description: Adds Duplicate draft to post lists. Copies title/content/excerpt only; private custom fields, builder data and terms are not copied. Requires edit/create capabilities and a nonce.

public-meta-viewer.name: Private admin viewer for public metadata
public-meta-viewer.code:
add_action( 'add_meta_boxes', static function () { if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) { return; } add_meta_box( 'codeslot_public_meta', 'Public metadata — review before sharing', static function ( $post ) { if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) { return; } $data = array(); foreach ( get_post_meta( $post->ID ) as $key => $values ) { if ( ! is_protected_meta( $key, 'post' ) ) { $data[ $key ] = $values; } } echo '
' . esc_html( substr( wp_json_encode( $data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ), 0, 20000 ) ) . '
'; }, null, 'normal' ); } );
public-meta-viewer.description: Administrator-only editor metabox. Protected keys are excluded, but public custom fields can still contain private information; review before sharing.

sticky-category.name: Prioritize sticky posts in category archives
sticky-category.code:
add_action( 'pre_get_posts', static function ( $query ) { if ( ! is_admin() && $query->is_main_query() && $query->is_category() ) { $query->set( 'ignore_sticky_posts', false ); } } );
add_filter( 'posts_orderby', static function ( $orderby, $query ) { global $wpdb; if ( ! is_admin() && $query->is_main_query() && $query->is_category() ) { $ids = array_map( 'absint', get_option( 'sticky_posts', array() ) ); if ( $ids ) { return 'FIELD(' . $wpdb->posts . '.ID,' . implode( ',', $ids ) . ') DESC, ' . $orderby; } } return $orderby; }, 10, 2 );
sticky-category.description: Prioritize sticky posts in category archives. Review before activation.

minimum-words.name: Minimum word count before publish
minimum-words.code: add_filter( 'wp_insert_post_data', static function ( $data ) { if ( 'post' === $data['post_type'] && 'publish' === $data['post_status'] && str_word_count( wp_strip_all_tags( $data['post_content'] ) ) < 100 ) { $data['post_status'] = 'draft'; } return $data; } );
minimum-words.description: Posts under 100 words remain drafts. Word counting is Latin-word based; adjust for your content language. Review scheduled/API publishing behavior.

autosave-config.name: Set editor autosave interval
autosave-config.description: Manual setup: add to wp-config.php before WordPress loads, replacing any existing definition. Sets autosave to five minutes. Do not activate as a snippet.

file-editor-config.name: Disable WordPress plugin/theme file editors
file-editor-config.description: Manual setup: add to wp-config.php before WordPress loads, replacing any existing definition. CodeSlot requires edit_plugins and may become inaccessible; keep filesystem recovery access. Do not activate as a snippet.

trash-days-config.name: Configure automatic trash retention
trash-days-config.description: Manual setup: add to wp-config.php before WordPress loads, replacing any existing definition. Keeps trash for sixty days. Zero disables trash and makes deletions permanent. Do not activate as a snippet.
